commits.message:
fix(csp): never throw on a hostile report, count every directive, do not guess "since"

- A report field that is not text (for example {"toString": null}) made the
  normalizers throw, so the promised empty 204 became a 500. Non-text is now
  no text at all, and the processing is also wrapped so the answer is the
  same 204 whatever arrives.
- The stats query returned only the ten busiest directives although the total
  is their sum, so reports for more than ten were undercounted. It returns
  them all (the parser has 19 plus "other") and the display keeps five.
- The page no longer carries a fixed "collected since" date. When reporting
  began is a Worker setting (CSP_REPORTING_SINCE, empty until someone has
  confirmed the live header has report-uri). While it is empty the page shows
  a dash and "reporting is not switched on yet" instead of a zero, since a
  zero from before anything could report looks like assurance; reports that
  are arriving show regardless.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
